content: {"like":["Enjoys action-packed movies with strong visual elements like sharks and hiking camps","Values high-quality viewing experiences, appreciating 4K and Blu-ray formats","Shows enthusiasm for movies that are described as great or sooo good","Has a preference for sequels or series, noting earlier installments were better","Expresses strong affection for films, often using phrases like \"love this movie\""],"dislike":["Dislikes missing closed captions, especially in deleted scenes","Finds it frustrating when deleted scenes lack captions","Is disappointed by the absence of certain plot elements, such as a hangover scene","Dislikes censorship that removes bad words while leaving nudity and sex uncensored","Expresses disappointment over the lack of a sequel, e.g., no next Karate Kid (part 4)"]}
